strings.bench.title: Trust & AutopsyBench — Accuracy vs. human effort
strings.bench.desc: Evaluates selective accuracy under abstention, coverage across difficulty tiers, and human effort per verified resolution.
strings.bench.syntheticBody: All default datasets and AutopsyBench scenarios use synthetic wholesale ledgers with planted cycle-count anomalies. Detection F1 (100%) is true by construction; judge performance by selective root-cause accuracy, abstention discipline, and human effort per verified resolution.
strings.bench.thresholdsSub: Measured across 60 synthetic scenarios (20 Easy / 20 Medium / 20 Hard) from RESULTS.md
strings.bench.llmBaselineDesc: Off by default. Sends the same synthetic ledger CSV directly to Gemini via API (requires GEMINI_API_KEY) and scores root-cause accuracy, entity grounding, and abstention with the same evaluator.

strings.narrative.UNRECORDED_TRANSFER: Case {caseId} ({sku} at {warehouse}): Ledger balance is {expectedQty} vs. physical count {countedQty} (discrepancy {varianceUnits}, exposure {varianceValue}). Check [{checkText}] indicates an unrecorded transfer from this hotspot ({confidence}% confidence).
strings.narrative.CUTOFF_TIMING: Case {caseId} ({sku} at {warehouse}): Ledger balance is {expectedQty} vs. physical count {countedQty} (discrepancy {varianceUnits}, exposure {varianceValue}). Check [{checkText}] flagged movement inside the cycle-count window ({confidence}% confidence).
strings.narrative.ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT: Case {caseId} ({sku} at {warehouse}): Abstaining on {expectedQty} vs. {countedQty} (discrepancy {varianceUnits}, exposure {varianceValue}). Evidence for {docRef} is below threshold ({confidence}% confidence); requesting minimum evidence before closure.

strings.trust.missedGate.0: Target Gate: Achieve >= 85.0% coverage at >= 95.0% selective accuracy on Hard multi-cause overlapping discrepancies (unposted receipt + cutoff timing drift in the same SKU within a 48h window).
strings.trust.missedGate.1: Observed Result: At the 0.778 abstention threshold, Hard-tier coverage reached 60.0% (91.7% selective accuracy), missing the 85.0% Hard-tier coverage gate by 25.0 percentage points. The agent safely abstained on 40.0% of Hard cases rather than guessing.
strings.trust.knownLimits.0: Synthetic distribution bias: Transaction timing, pack multipliers (2x/12x/24x), and bin transfers follow clean synthetic distributions rather than messy ERP reversal chains.
strings.trust.knownLimits.1: Compound same-window anomalies: When two opposing errors partially cancel (e.g. +24 unposted receipt and -18 transfer leaving +6 net), single-cause heuristics abstain rather than decomposing linear combinations.
strings.trust.knownLimits.2: No autonomous ERP writeback: Corrective adjustments are prepared for human approval and never written directly to external ERP systems in the MVP.
strings.trust.knownLimits.3: LLM baseline scope: The optional raw-CSV LLM baseline (scripts/run_llm_baseline.ts) processes truncated CSV slices to fit context windows and is off by default without an API key.
